title.zh: Trump ethics fight sinks CLARITY Act in dramatic Senate defeat
title.en: Trump ethics fight sinks CLARITY Act in dramatic Senate defeat

current_state.zh: The Senate failed to invoke cloture on the CLARITY Act after bipartisan negotiations collapsed over ethics rules, leaving the major US crypto market-structure bill off the floor.
